propositions: Fixture setup consumes 47% of tests/interfaces wall-clock due to function-scoped rebar_repo spawning git processes (306 ms, 58 spawns per test) across 589 consumers.

Session-scoped template with per-test copytree reduces initialization from 306 ms to 22.3 ms (13.7x), but copies must be fixed: rewrite git worktree pointers, set REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR per test, re-randomize .env-id and .signing-key, reset _pending_cache, and build template in isolated MonkeyPatch context to prevent environment leakage.

Bare git worktree repair is a silent no-op when validating by path existence (template still exists), leaving the copy using the template's object store and refs; the guard must check git worktree list --porcelain paths fall inside REBAR_ROOT, not the weaker --git-common-dir check.

Shared snapshot store keyed by commit SHA (with source=attested/ref=HEAD forced per test) would allow ~150 tests to collide on one template entry; per-test REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR and per-test re-randomization of .env-id/.signing-key preserve test isolation.

Template fixture must build inside pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() setting REBAR_ROOT to template dir and clearing REBAR_TRACKER_DIR/REBAR_TRACKER_BRANCH/REBAR_CONFIG to prevent first test's autouse environment from contaminating the template.

Sentinel tests must prove HALF-FIXED copies are rejected, bare worktree repair fails, writes do not leak between stores, no file contains template path, and .env-id/.signing-key are re-randomized by unconditional write (not guarded idempotent helpers).
